title: Bookshop
description: Two tables, 64 books, 28 authors. The first SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIKE and IS NULL.

reset.sql:
-- Bookshop. Two tables and nothing else -- this dataset exists so the
-- first SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY and LIKE have something to work on.
CREATE TABLE authors (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  country TEXT NOT NULL,
  birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE books (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  author_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authors(id),
  genre TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (genre IN ('fiction','mystery','science','history','biography','poetry')),
  price REAL NOT NULL,
  published_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pages INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- NULL means the book is not part of a series. IS NULL is worth practising.
  series TEXT,
  in_stock INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (in_stock IN (0,1))
);
